name: Zhong Yang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhong Yang Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of optical lens molds in Taiwan, China, Korea, and internationally. The company provides glass lenses, plastic lenses, mold for glass molding, mold for injection molding, and special mold core. It also offers mobile phone lenses and other optical lens molds used in mobile phone lenses, automotive lenses, projectors, scanners, etc. Zhong Yang Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.
